name: Mormons
overview: Scripture reveals the uniqueness and supremacy of the LORD as the only true God, who is eternal and alone worthy of worship, as declared in Isaiah 44:6. The incarnation of the Word, who is God and became flesh (John 1:1, 14), affirms the centrality of Christ as the only Redeemer. While Jesus speaks of other sheep outside the immediate fold (John 10:16), the Bible consistently emphasizes God’s exclusive revelation through His prophets (Amos 3:7) and the Spirit’s work in bringing life to what was dead (Ezekiel 37:1). This foundation challenges teachings that deviate from the biblical portrayal of God and Christ.
